subject: SLA & support onboarding checklist needed to complete vendor setup
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Hart <procurement@nimbusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: SLA & support onboarding checklist needed to complete vendor setup

Hi Jessica —

Welcome — were excited to get Nimbus Analytics set up in Redwood. Procurement is starting the vendor setup and we need a few items to move to PO and onboarding. Can you please confirm the following and attach any templates you have: 

1) Support / SLA roster: primary and secondary support contacts, escalation path (L1/L2/engineering), and after-hours coverage.
2) Standard uptime / availability SLOs you commit to (monthly uptime target + maintenance windows).
3) Incident response SLA (ack / remediation windows) and the on-call rotation.
4) Billing info for PO: legal name, billing address, W9 (or equivalent), tax ID, and preferred PO terms (net30/net45).
5) Any standard onboarding forms you expect us to complete (security, connectivity, IP allowlists).

Ive attached Redwoods Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf and our SLA template so you can fill in the fields we need. If you can return the completed forms and your support roster today, Finance (ccd Hannah) will begin the PO. Marissa (sales) and Rishi (support) are looped in to help with technical or service questions.

Suggested next step: if it helps, lets schedule a 30-minute sync to map escalation paths.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf), Redwood-SLA-Template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Jessica Hart <jessica.hart@nimbusai.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 10:02:14 -0800
Subject: Re: SLA & support onboarding checklist needed to complete vendor setup

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Attaching our standard support roster and our most recent SOC2 report. High level answers below and please see the attached roster for names/phone numbers: 

- Uptime: We operate to a contractual target of 99.95% monthly availability for our hosted inference endpoints; planned maintenance windows are typically 2x/month during low-traffic hours and we provide 72-hour advance notice except for emergency patches.
- Incident response: P1 ack within 15 minutes, remediation goal within 4 hours; P2 ack within 1 hour, remediation goal within 24 hours.
- Escalation: L1/Support Tier -> L2/Platform Engineer -> L3/SRE -> Customer Success Director. After-hours phone coverage for P1 incidents.
- Billing: Nimbus Analytics, Inc. 
  Billing address: 221 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105
  Tax ID: 12-3456789
  W9 attached. Preferred terms: net30.

We filled the SLA template where possible and included contact phones in the roster. If you need a shorter SLA (99.9%) for a different pricing tier, we can propose that as an option; the above reflects our standard offering.

Attachments: Nimbus-Support-Roster.xlsx, Nimbus-SOC2-Report.pdf, Nimbus_W9.pdf

Best,
Jessica Hart
Vendor Programs Lead
Nimbus Analytics

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 13:20:37 -0800
Subject: Re: SLA & support onboarding checklist needed to complete vendor setup

Jessica —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the SOC2 docs. A few clarifications so Finance can cut the PO and Support can onboard cleanly: 

- Uptime requirement: Redwood procurement baseline is 99.9% for standard vendors. Your 99.95% standard is fine; can you confirm if there are any SLA credits or penalties we should include in the PO for drops below 99.9%? Please call out the SLA credit formula if applicable.
- After-hours: good to hear there is phone coverage for P1. Please confirm the timezone coverage (PST coverage or follow-the-sun).
- Contact roster: can you highlight an L2 on-call name + mobile? We need a dedicated L2 escalation contact for the first 90 days of the integration.
- PO: Hannah — billing address above is fine; we need the W9 and a completed PO form (I attached our Vendor_Onboarding_Form). Please confirm if Nimbus requires any onboarding deposit or initial invoice terms.

If Nimbus can fill in the SLA worksheet and return the roster with the L2 mobile, Rishi will pick up the technical onboarding and Ill circulate the PO draft to finance. Also, Marissa — if there are pricing tiers tied to SLOs (e.g., 99.95 vs 99.9), can you confirm pricing impact so I can include it in the PO justification?

Thanks — if easier we can do a quick call; propose tomorrow 9:00 AM PT.

Best,
Monica

Thanks — Ill own the technical support onboarding and confirm the L2 mapping. Jessica, can you and I do a 30-minute run-through tomorrow 9:00 AM PT (Ill send a calendar invite)? I want to validate escalation flows, PagerDuty integration, and any runbook handoffs.

Monica: once the roster includes L2 mobile and your PO draft is ready, Ill start the connectivity tests with Nimbus staging endpoints.

Rishi Malhotra

Redwood Inference
